learnings: Gemini Nano Banana models produce best results with highly specific spatial descriptions rather than abstract concepts
Always specify 'flat vector logo, no photorealistic elements, clean background' to avoid photo-style outputs
Including negative instructions ('no gradients', 'no 3D shadows') significantly improves logo-appropriate outputs

effective: Specifying exact geometric shapes and their spatial relationships
Including 'professional brand mark, suitable for business cards and app icons' as context
Describing the negative space explicitly when it carries meaning
ineffective: Vague descriptors like 'modern and clean' without visual specifics
Requesting text/typography in the image - AI letterforms are often garbled
Asking for multiple logo variants in a single generation - produces collages instead of clean marks
